title: Teachers and his first band, the Imperial
summary: He names his teachers (Chaligny, Touro, David Jones) and lists the players in his first band, then Isaiah's Young Morgan band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: And now, I've taken lessons with Pinchback Two Row. You heard of him?
Oh, yes. I've heard of him. Had a brass band.

Had a brass band. And he had charge of the WPA band too some time back. And now, I've taken a few lessons with David Jones. Oh, yeah. I was on tenor saxophone. And I come in to play any different little bands. Well, our first band was then, if I'm not making a mistake, it's the Imperial. Well, Jack August was playing alto saxophone. I was playing the clarinet. Willie Webber was playing trumpet. And Dr. Bechier, who was that? Oh, yeah. He played trombone? Oh, he was playing trombone. I knew him very well. Yeah. Well, then we played together for a while and we had a bass player by the name of Hudson. Yeah, that's been there, yeah. Oh. Well, that's been quite a while back. I think he's dead. Then after I started playing, then Arthur Durdne came into the band. He was a trumpet player. Me, Arthur Durdne, Whitney Arsenault, Whitney Arsenault, and Whitney Arsenault, and Dr. Bechier. Then I can't think of the drummer that we had playing, but I remember when Kid Howard came to the band. He played drums. Yeah, he played drums. I would come and play drum with us a while.
